Sourced directly from Raipur—India’s premier steel manufacturing hub—these bars represent a massive network of high-capacity foundries. - Maximum Cost Efficiency: Optimized production logistics in Raipur pass direct manufacturing savings onto your project budget.

data.name: GK TMT
data.description:
## GK TMT Rebars (Fe 550D / Fe 500D)
Overview
GK TMT (manufactured by Real Ispat and Power Ltd / REAL Group) is a premium thermo-mechanically treated reinforcement bar engineered for modern construction demands. Manufactured in compliance with IS 1786:2008 standards, GK TMT bars deliver an optimal balance of high tensile strength, superior ductility, and robust corrosion resistance.

With advanced ribbed profiling and a tough outer tempered martensite layer combined with a ductile ferrite-pearlite core, GK TMT provides exceptional concrete bonding and high structural integrity against seismic activity.

## Key Features & Benefits
- High Yield & Tensile Strength: Built to withstand heavy load-bearing requirements, resulting in 12–14% steel savings and lower structural weight.

- Superior Ductility & Seismic Resistance: The high elongation properties allow structures to absorb high energy loads and seismic shocks without brittle fracture.

- Advanced Rib Design: Precision-rolled rib pattern provides a solid mechanical grip and maximum bonding strength with concrete.

- Enhanced Corrosion & Heat Resistance: Low carbon, sulfur, and phosphorus composition protects against rust formation and maintains stability under severe temperature variations.

- Excellent Bendability & Weldability: Easily bent into required shapes on-site without developing micro-cracks, and compatible with standard welding methods without loss of joint strength.

data.name: JINDAL PANTHER TMT
data.description:
## Overview
[Jindal Panther TMT Rebars](https://www.jindalpanther.com/post/our-blogs/tmt-bars-importance-features-and-extensive-usage.html) are premium-quality, high-strength primary steel reinforcement bars manufactured from virgin iron ore. Engineered using the advanced High Yield Quenching and Self Tempering (HYQST) process, these **Fe 550D** grade rebars deliver a perfect combination of superior yield strength and high ductility. They are **BIS Certified** and specifically designed to meet stringent global and domestic structural demands. 

## Technical Specifications
- **Grade:** Fe 550D (Enhanced Ductility)
- **Yield Strength:** Minimum 550 MPa (N/mm²)
- **Tensile Strength (UTS):** Minimum 600 N/mm²
- **Elongation:** Minimum 14.5%
- **Raw Material:** Primary Steel manufactured from virgin iron ore
- **Chemical Purity:** Exceptionally low levels of Sulphur and Phosphorus (Max 0.075% combined) to prevent fatigue and cold shortness
- **Standards:** Conforms to IS 1786:2008

## Key Features & Benefits
- **Advanced HYQST & QST Technology:** Manufactured using globally recognized Quenching and Self Tempering (QST) and High Yield Quenching and Self Tempering (HYQST) processes. This specialized thermo-mechanical treatment rapidly cools the outer layer while the core remains hot, creating a unique composite structure: a tough, high-strength martensite outer ring combined with a soft, ductile inner core.
- **Exceptional Seismic Resistance:** The enhanced ductility and elongation of the Fe 550D grade allow structures to absorb and dissipate seismic energy effectively, making them highly suitable for earthquake-prone areas (Seismic Zones IV & V).
- **Cost & Material Efficiency:** Because Fe 550D offers a higher load-bearing capacity than standard Fe 500 grades, it can reduce overall steel consumption by up to 12-15%, which eases bar congestion during construction and saves on material costs.
- **Superior Weldability & Bendability:** A low carbon equivalent enables excellent weldability without pre-heating, and the bars can be bent easily without cracking (e.g., a minimum bend radius of 6 mm for 12 mm bars).
- **Strong Concrete Bonding:** A uniform, precision-milled V-shaped rib pattern ensures superior mechanical bonding with concrete.
- **Corrosion Resistance:** The specialized cooling process creates a tough, passive outer layer that naturally resists rust formation better than standard scrap-based rebars.

## Ideal Applications
- High-rise residential and commercial buildings
- Heavy infrastructure, bridges, and elevated corridors
- Structures in high-stress and dynamic loading environments
- Earthquake-resistant foundations and frameworks

data.name: BHUMIJA TMT BARS
data.description:
# **Bhumija TMT Rebars (Fe 500D / Fe 550)**

### **Overview**

**Bhumija TMT** (manufactured by Bhumija Ispat) is a high-grade thermo-mechanically treated reinforcement bar designed to meet modern structural engineering and construction requirements. Certified under **IS 1786:2008** standards, Bhumija TMT bars are processed through a stringent **TIA (Testing, Inspection, and Assurance)** quality framework to deliver consistent load-bearing capability, high ductility, and enhanced durability.

Manufactured with a uniform rib design, these rebars ensure a powerful grip with concrete while maintaining optimal bendability and corrosion resistance.

---

### **Key Features & Benefits**

* **High Tensile & Yield Strength:** Delivers robust structural load capacity, enabling efficient steel consumption across projects.
* **Superior Ductility & Flexibility:** High elongation prevents brittle failures and allows effective energy absorption during seismic activity.
* **Uniform Rib Pattern:** Precision-engineered external ribs ensure maximum concrete bonding strength and slip resistance.
* **Corrosion & Thermal Resistance:** Low-impurity chemical composition resists rust in humid environments and retains strength under elevated temperatures.
* **Excellent Bendability & Weldability:** Easily bent and rebent without micro-fracturing along the core, suitable for on-site fabrication.

---

### **Technical Specifications**

| **Parameter** | **Specification** |
| --- | --- |
| **Brand** | Bhumija TMT |
| **Manufacturer** | Bhumija Ispat |
| **Compliance Standard** | IS 1786:2008 / BIS Certified |
| **Grades Available** | Fe 415 / Fe 500 / Fe 500D / Fe 550 |
| **Available Diameters** | 8 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 16 mm, 20 mm, 25 mm, 32 mm |
| **Standard Length** | 12 Meters (Straight / U-Bend) |
| **Rib Type** | High-Bond Uniform Ribbed |
| **Quality Mechanism** | TIA (Testing, Inspection, Assurance) Process |

---

### **Recommended Applications**

* **Residential Housing & Apartments:** Individual homes, multi-story residential blocks, beams, and columns.
* **Commercial & High-Rise Buildings:** Office towers, shopping complexes, and retail centers.
* **Infrastructure & Bridges:** Culverts, flyovers, highways, and heavy structural frameworks.
* **Industrial Structures:** Warehouses, factory plants, and heavy machine foundation slabs.

data.name: ISI TMT RAIPUR
data.description:
## Raipur ISI TMT Bars

Raipur ISI TMT Bars provide the ultimate cost-effective solution for structural reinforcement without compromising on safety standards. Sourced directly from Raipur—India’s premier steel manufacturing hub—these bars represent a massive network of high-capacity foundries. By leveraging Raipur's massive economies of scale, we bring you fully certified, dependable TMT bars at the most competitive market prices.

## Why Choose Raipur ISI TMT Bars?

- Certified Safety: Every bar carries the mandatory ISI mark, guaranteeing compliance with national standard engineering benchmarks.
- Maximum Cost Efficiency: Optimized production logistics in Raipur pass direct manufacturing savings onto your project budget.
- Versatile Material Grades: Available across a wide spectrum of industry grades to match your specific structural blueprints.
- Massive Supply Reliability: Sourced from India's largest steel cluster, ensuring zero project delays and uninterrupted bulk availability.

## Ideal Applications

- Budget-Conscious Construction: Perfect for low-to-medium rise residential buildings looking to optimize material expenses.

- Boundary Walls & Fencing: Highly economical choice for extensive peripheral walls, security fencing, and compound enclosures.

- Secondary Structural Elements: Excellent for casting internal lintels, sunshades, chajjas, and non-load-bearing structural frames.

- Rural & Semi-Urban Projects: The go-to affordable steel choice for independent home builders, warehouses, and small commercial shops.

data.name: GK TMT
data.description:
## GK TMT Rebars (Fe 550D / Fe 500D)
Overview
GK TMT (manufactured by Real Ispat and Power Ltd / REAL Group) is a premium thermo-mechanically treated reinforcement bar engineered for modern construction demands. Manufactured in compliance with IS 1786:2008 standards, GK TMT bars deliver an optimal balance of high tensile strength, superior ductility, and robust corrosion resistance.

With advanced ribbed profiling and a tough outer tempered martensite layer combined with a ductile ferrite-pearlite core, GK TMT provides exceptional concrete bonding and high structural integrity against seismic activity.

## Key Features & Benefits
- High Yield & Tensile Strength: Built to withstand heavy load-bearing requirements, resulting in 12–14% steel savings and lower structural weight.

- Superior Ductility & Seismic Resistance: The high elongation properties allow structures to absorb high energy loads and seismic shocks without brittle fracture.

- Advanced Rib Design: Precision-rolled rib pattern provides a solid mechanical grip and maximum bonding strength with concrete.

- Enhanced Corrosion & Heat Resistance: Low carbon, sulfur, and phosphorus composition protects against rust formation and maintains stability under severe temperature variations.

- Excellent Bendability & Weldability: Easily bent into required shapes on-site without developing micro-cracks, and compatible with standard welding methods without loss of joint strength.

data.name: JINDAL PANTHER TMT
data.description:
## Overview
[Jindal Panther TMT Rebars](https://www.jindalpanther.com/post/our-blogs/tmt-bars-importance-features-and-extensive-usage.html) are premium-quality, high-strength primary steel reinforcement bars manufactured from virgin iron ore. Engineered using the advanced High Yield Quenching and Self Tempering (HYQST) process, these **Fe 550D** grade rebars deliver a perfect combination of superior yield strength and high ductility. They are **BIS Certified** and specifically designed to meet stringent global and domestic structural demands. 

## Technical Specifications
- **Grade:** Fe 550D (Enhanced Ductility)
- **Yield Strength:** Minimum 550 MPa (N/mm²)
- **Tensile Strength (UTS):** Minimum 600 N/mm²
- **Elongation:** Minimum 14.5%
- **Raw Material:** Primary Steel manufactured from virgin iron ore
- **Chemical Purity:** Exceptionally low levels of Sulphur and Phosphorus (Max 0.075% combined) to prevent fatigue and cold shortness
- **Standards:** Conforms to IS 1786:2008

## Key Features & Benefits
- **Advanced HYQST & QST Technology:** Manufactured using globally recognized Quenching and Self Tempering (QST) and High Yield Quenching and Self Tempering (HYQST) processes. This specialized thermo-mechanical treatment rapidly cools the outer layer while the core remains hot, creating a unique composite structure: a tough, high-strength martensite outer ring combined with a soft, ductile inner core.
- **Exceptional Seismic Resistance:** The enhanced ductility and elongation of the Fe 550D grade allow structures to absorb and dissipate seismic energy effectively, making them highly suitable for earthquake-prone areas (Seismic Zones IV & V).
- **Cost & Material Efficiency:** Because Fe 550D offers a higher load-bearing capacity than standard Fe 500 grades, it can reduce overall steel consumption by up to 12-15%, which eases bar congestion during construction and saves on material costs.
- **Superior Weldability & Bendability:** A low carbon equivalent enables excellent weldability without pre-heating, and the bars can be bent easily without cracking (e.g., a minimum bend radius of 6 mm for 12 mm bars).
- **Strong Concrete Bonding:** A uniform, precision-milled V-shaped rib pattern ensures superior mechanical bonding with concrete.
- **Corrosion Resistance:** The specialized cooling process creates a tough, passive outer layer that naturally resists rust formation better than standard scrap-based rebars.

## Ideal Applications
- High-rise residential and commercial buildings
- Heavy infrastructure, bridges, and elevated corridors
- Structures in high-stress and dynamic loading environments
- Earthquake-resistant foundations and frameworks

data.name: BHUMIJA TMT BARS
data.description:
# **Bhumija TMT Rebars (Fe 500D / Fe 550)**

### **Overview**

**Bhumija TMT** (manufactured by Bhumija Ispat) is a high-grade thermo-mechanically treated reinforcement bar designed to meet modern structural engineering and construction requirements. Certified under **IS 1786:2008** standards, Bhumija TMT bars are processed through a stringent **TIA (Testing, Inspection, and Assurance)** quality framework to deliver consistent load-bearing capability, high ductility, and enhanced durability.

Manufactured with a uniform rib design, these rebars ensure a powerful grip with concrete while maintaining optimal bendability and corrosion resistance.

---

### **Key Features & Benefits**

* **High Tensile & Yield Strength:** Delivers robust structural load capacity, enabling efficient steel consumption across projects.
* **Superior Ductility & Flexibility:** High elongation prevents brittle failures and allows effective energy absorption during seismic activity.
* **Uniform Rib Pattern:** Precision-engineered external ribs ensure maximum concrete bonding strength and slip resistance.
* **Corrosion & Thermal Resistance:** Low-impurity chemical composition resists rust in humid environments and retains strength under elevated temperatures.
* **Excellent Bendability & Weldability:** Easily bent and rebent without micro-fracturing along the core, suitable for on-site fabrication.

---

### **Technical Specifications**

| **Parameter** | **Specification** |
| --- | --- |
| **Brand** | Bhumija TMT |
| **Manufacturer** | Bhumija Ispat |
| **Compliance Standard** | IS 1786:2008 / BIS Certified |
| **Grades Available** | Fe 415 / Fe 500 / Fe 500D / Fe 550 |
| **Available Diameters** | 8 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 16 mm, 20 mm, 25 mm, 32 mm |
| **Standard Length** | 12 Meters (Straight / U-Bend) |
| **Rib Type** | High-Bond Uniform Ribbed |
| **Quality Mechanism** | TIA (Testing, Inspection, Assurance) Process |

---

### **Recommended Applications**

* **Residential Housing & Apartments:** Individual homes, multi-story residential blocks, beams, and columns.
* **Commercial & High-Rise Buildings:** Office towers, shopping complexes, and retail centers.
* **Infrastructure & Bridges:** Culverts, flyovers, highways, and heavy structural frameworks.
* **Industrial Structures:** Warehouses, factory plants, and heavy machine foundation slabs.
